svg.title: How ecmwf-multi-agents works
svg.desc: You talk to lead; it plans, hands work to helpers, keeps answering you while they work, and has changes reviewed. Here: you ask for a --json option; lead asks one question, sends a scout, runs two builders in the background, answers your other question meanwhile, has the change reviewed and reports back.

g.text: Print the JSON to stdout, or to a file?
Done: --json added, tests pass, review: APPROVE.

svg.text: Optional, off by default: researcher, tester, designer, data-scientist
